name: Middle Fork Salmon — Boundary Creek to Cache Bar
description: A 98-mile permitted wilderness run from Boundary Creek down to Cache Bar, tracing the Middle Fork of the Salmon through the heart of the Frank Church-River of No Return Wilderness. Widely regarded as the finest multi-day whitewater trip in the Lower 48: five to seven days of nearly continuous Class III–IV rapids, technical low-water boulder gardens giving way to pushy big-water waves as the river builds, with over 300 named drops between the put-in and the confluence. Between rapids you'll find natural hot springs on the bank, side-canyon hikes to painted-rock pictographs, and camping under some of the darkest skies in the country — no roads, no cell service, and no bailout points once you launch.
hazards: Remote wilderness, no cell service, no road access between put-in and take-out
Continuous Class III–IV at standard flows; rated higher at high water
points_of_interest: Velvet Falls (II–IV): first major drop, ~5 mi in
Pistol Creek (III–IV): tight S-turn between cliff walls
Loon Creek Hot Spring + Sunflower Hot Springs along the run
usgs_site_name: MF Salmon River at MF Lodge nr Yellow Pine, ID (Station 13309220)
